title: Fill Frequency defaults to PE-DESIGN's 30 %: 1.2 mm per row
description: A 40 × 40 mm fill at 0° with 4 mm stitches and no Frequency set: the needle grid moves 30 % of a stitch (1.2 mm) from row to row, PE-DESIGN 11's default, ±2 % of the stitch length. Designs saved before the default (no Frequency stored) keep the old ⅓ stagger (engine test new_fills_take_pe_frequency_and_old_files_keep_the_third_stagger).

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference stitches/sweep-fill-density-4p5.pes (spec sweep-fill-density-4p5): made at every default, Frequency field 30 %, rows shift 1.2 mm with 4.0 mm stitches. Coordinator decision 2026-10-27 (TRACKS.md Spec questions): the observation replaces the earlier ⅓ hypothesis.

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN's default Frequency 30 % = 1.2 mm per row (sweep-fill-density-4p5.pes); ±2 % of the stitch length
region_compat: more than 50 rows of needle points
